items.distractor_fact: Väderleksinstitutets mätstation visade {D} grader Celsius samma morgon.
items.gloss_en: The weather institute's measuring station showed {D} degrees Celsius the same morning.
items.entity_note: The weather institute's measuring station is an organisation-owned instrument, differing in kind from the first distractor's neighboring village (a place).

items.distractor_fact: En börsmäklare värderade en jämförbar aktie till {D} kronor samma dag.
items.gloss_en: A stockbroker valued a comparable stock at {D} kronor the same day.
items.entity_note: The stockbroker is a person, differing in kind from the first distractor's other company (an organisation).

items.distractor_fact: Kommunens miljökontor mätte grundvattnet till {D} meter över sitt eget referensmärke samma kväll.
items.gloss_en: The municipal environmental office measured the groundwater at {D} meters above its own reference mark the same evening.
items.entity_note: The municipal office is an organisation, differing in kind from the first distractor's neighboring lake (a place); the groundwater has its own separate reference mark.

items.distractor_fact: Flygledningen registrerade en höjd på {D} meter över havet för ett annat flygplan vid samma tillfälle.
items.gloss_en: Air traffic control registered an altitude of {D} meters above sea level for another aircraft at the same time.
items.entity_note: Air traffic control is an organisation, differing in kind from the first distractor's other climber (a person).

items.distractor_fact: Vårdcentralens andra våg visade {D} kilogram vid en kalibreringskontroll.
items.gloss_en: The health center's other scale showed {D} kilograms during a calibration check.
items.entity_note: The clinic's scale is an instrument, differing in kind from the first distractor's other patient (a person).

items.distractor_fact: Statistikmyndigheten registrerade {D} invånare för en annan tätort vid samma folkräkning.
items.gloss_en: The statistics authority registered {D} inhabitants for another town at the same census.
items.entity_note: The statistics authority is an organisation, differing in kind from the first distractor's neighboring village (a place).

items.distractor_fact: En annan förare uppgav en hastighet på {D} kilometer i timmen vid samma kurva enligt sin egen mätning.
items.gloss_en: Another driver reported a speed of {D} kilometers per hour at the same curve according to their own measurement.
items.entity_note: The driver is a person self-reporting, differing in kind from the first distractor's other car (an instrument).

items.distractor_fact: En annan kontoinnehavare satte in {D} kronor på sitt konto under samma månad.
items.gloss_en: Another account holder deposited {D} kronor into their own account during the same month.
items.entity_note: The account holder is a person, differing in kind from the first distractor's other account (an object/instrument).

items.distractor_fact: En oberoende konsult beräknade en kostnad på {D} kronor för ett eget uppdrag under kvartalet.
items.gloss_en: An independent consultant calculated a cost of {D} kronor for their own assignment during the quarter.
items.entity_note: The consultant is a person, differing in kind from the first distractor's other company (an organisation).

items.distractor_fact: En enskild spelare gjorde {D} mål i en annan match under säsongen.
items.gloss_en: An individual player scored {D} goals in another match during the season.
items.entity_note: The individual player is a person, differing in kind from the first distractor's other team (an organisation).

items.distractor_fact: En fond i samma bransch redovisade en vinst på {D} kronor under året.
items.gloss_en: A fund in the same industry reported a profit of {D} kronor during the year.
items.entity_note: The fund is an organisation, differing in kind from the first distractor's other investor (a person).

items.distractor_fact: En annan produktionslinje utanför koncernen tillverkade {D} enheter under samma vecka, mätt mot sitt eget separata mål.
items.gloss_en: Another production line outside the group manufactured {D} units during the same week, measured against its own separate target.
items.entity_note: The production line is an object/instrument, differing in kind from the first distractor's other factory in the group (an organisation); its own target is unstated here, so the story's target does not apply to it.

items.distractor_fact: I en tidigare säsongs tävling gjordes ett resultat på {D} slag på ett hål vars par inte anges här.
items.gloss_en: In a previous season's tournament, a score of {D} strokes was made on a hole whose par is not stated here.
items.entity_note: The previous tournament is a different series/occasion, differing in kind from the first distractor's other golfer (a person); its hole's par is never given, so the story's stated par does not apply.

items.distractor_fact: En resenär noterade att ett fristående tåg anlände klockan som motsvarar {D} minuter efter midnatt, enligt sin egen tidtabell.
items.gloss_en: A traveler noted that an independent train arrived at the equivalent of {D} minutes after midnight, according to its own timetable.
items.entity_note: The traveler is a person, differing in kind from the first distractor's other train line (an organisation); the independent train follows its own timetable, not the one stated in the story.
